validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE / CLASSIFICATION / DUPLICATE all clear. Zone 3 East-to-West Project is a real, FERC-jurisdictional bi-directional-flow-reversal project on the Rockies Express (REX) mainline, confirmed by THREE mutually independent origins: (1) Tallgrass corporate-family SEC filings -- a Tallgrass Energy Partners LP 8-K exhibit (d177254dex992.htm) states 'In June 2014, in Docket No. CP14-498-000, Rockies Express filed with FERC an application for a certificate of public convenience and necessity for authorization to modify, construct and operate certain facilities that will enable the bi-directional flow of natural gas on the Rockies Express mainline from Monroe County, Ohio to the existing Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America delivery interconnect... located in Moultrie County, Illinois,' and a Tallgrass Energy GP LP 8-K exhibit (REX's own FY2015 GAAP financial statements) independently restates the same project narrative with exact dates: order issued Feb 27 2015, construction commenced March 17 2015, commercial service began Aug 1 2015, all facilities in service Sept 1 2015, adding 1.2 million Dth/day 'without the addition of incremental compression horsepower or pipeline looping'; (2) EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects tracking workbook (a US government database, wholly independent of the Tallgrass corporate family) carries this EXACT project under the identical name 'Zone 3 East-to-West Project,' Pipeline Operator Name='Rockies Express Pipeline', Project Type='Reversal', Status='Completed', Completed Date=2015-09-01, Beg_State=OH, End_State=IL, Cost(millions)=79, Additional Capacity(MMcf/d)=1200, Miles=blank, Diameter=blank, Docket Number='CP14-498' -- an exact, independent match to the sheet's existing Docket-adjacent facts (SegmentCost=$79,000,000, StartState=Ohio, EndState=Illinois); (3) English Wikipedia's 'Rockies Express Pipeline' article independently corroborates the Aug 1, 2015 in-service date. DUPLICATE CHECK vs roster: this row (P5830, docket CP14-498-000) is textually and docket-wise distinct from the other two Rockies Express rows -- P5829 ('Seneca Lateral', a SEPARATE upstream lateral in Noble/Monroe Counties OH, dockets CP13-539/CP14-194/CP15-102) and P5831 ('Zone 3 Capacity Enhancement', a SEPARATE, later, compression-only project, docket CP15-137, filed March 2015, in service Jan 2017); no merge action needed -- confirms and closes out the cross-row lead P5829's own shard flagged pointing at this docket. CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission' is correct -- EIA's own 'Pipeline Type' field records 'Interstate' under FERC authority, and the company filings describe this as an NGA-jurisdictional mainline facility, not gathering/distribution. RouteType='Bidirectionality upgrade only' / RouteAccuracy='no route' (both already on the sheet) are CORRECT and should NOT be changed -- every source confirms this project reversed flow direction and added delivery-point capacity on EXISTING pipe, explicitly 'without the addition of incremental compression horsepower or pipeline looping,' so there is no new route to map. Opened and read to exhaustion: both Tallgrass-family 8-K exhibits (d177254dex992.htm and the REX FY2015 GAAP financial statements exhibit a991rex20151231gaapfinanci.htm), the TEP FY2017 10-K (which separately names 'Tallgrass NatGas Operator, LLC' as REX's day-to-day operator -- see the Operator fill note below for how this reconciles with 'Rockies Express Pipeline LLC'), the TGE FY2019 10-K, the Phillips 66 FY2018 10-K, the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (downloaded and parsed directly, not just cited from the wiki pool), and the English Wikipedia article. All 7 URLs cited in this shard were run through url_verifier and returned ok=true, name_found=true.

validity.recommendation: Change Capacity from 1800.00 to 1200.00 MMcf/d. The sheet's current 1800 MMcf/d appears to be the resulting TOTAL/aggregate Zone 3 bi-directional capacity after this project completed (0.6 Bcf/d already added by the separately-recorded Seneca Lateral, P5829, plus this project's own 1.2 Bcf/d = 1.8 Bcf/d combined), not this project's own incremental capacity addition.
validity.researcher_notes: TWO independent origins both explicitly describe this project's OWN incremental addition as 1.2 Bcf/d (1200 MMcf/d), not 1.8 Bcf/d: (1) EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook records 'Additional Capacity (MMcf/d)' = 1200 for the identically-named 'Zone 3 East-to-West Project' row (docket CP14-498, matching this row's docket exactly); (2) the Tallgrass corporate family's own SEC filings state twice, in near-identical language across two separate 8-K exhibits: 'The Zone 3 East-to-West Project was placed into commercial service on August 1, 2015 and creates an additional 1.2 million Dth per day of firm takeaway capacity from the Utica and Marcellus Shale Plays and the Appalachian Basin' (1 million Dth/day = ~1 MMcf/d, so 1.2 million Dth/day = ~1200 MMcf/d). Separately, English Wikipedia narrates the SAME August 1, 2015 event as making 'Zone 3 of the mainline fully bi-directional with the ability to move approximately 1.8 billion cubic feet per day' -- this 1.8 Bcf/d is the resulting TOTAL Zone-3 east-to-west capability after the project (i.e., the pre-existing 0.6 Bcf/d Seneca Lateral capacity, GEM's own P5829, plus this project's 1.2 Bcf/d addition = 1.8 Bcf/d combined), not this project's own incremental contribution -- and is very likely the source of the sheet's current 1800 MMcf/d value. This is a clean case of an aggregate/system-level figure recorded on an individual segment/project row (the recurring GEM data-quality pattern flagged in this batch's scope guidance). P5831's own already-staged shard (Zone 3 Capacity Enhancement, docket CP15-137) independently reached the identical conclusion via its own cross-row lead pointed at this row, using a different source (Phillips 66's FY2018 10-K segment table) -- so this finding is now corroborated a fourth way. Recommending Capacity be corrected to 1200.00 MMcf/d.
